thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Suspicious S3 access pattern detected from unknown IPs against staging bucket `staging-debug-logs`. Alert ID: ALRT-20260317-7. Runbook: /runbooks/s3-exfil. Please acknowledge.
ad a: ack, I'm taking lead. Pulling logs and IP list now. Which service identity is writing?
ada: quick grep shows `staging-log-forwarder` service principal making PUTs between 03:12-03:20 UTC to a new prefix `mirror/2026-03-17/`. IPs start with 52.34.*.* and 3.95.*.*.
secops: confirmed. Seen repeated `aws s3:PutObject` to unusual prefix and a few GETs. Traffic volume ~1.2GB in 8 minutes. Unknown external hostnames resolved after NAT. Possible exfil.
raj: I'm revoking staging-forwarder read/write keys now. Pushing deny policy to the role. ETA 2m.
ada: running snapshot of the bucket to immutable archive for forensics: `aws s3 cp s3://staging-debug-logs s3://forensics-temp/staging-snap-20260317 --recursive --metadata-directive REPLACE`
deploy-bot: Stopping log forwarder group `staging-forwarder` (run_id: fwd-7f4b). Service stop issued.
secops: applied WAF block for the current IP ranges and added network ACL deny on the NAT gateway. Also created quarantine bucket and copied suspicious prefix into `s3://quarantine-evidence/staging/20260317`. SHA256s stored in evidence ticket SECT-172.
tasha: Legal looped in (legal-sam). We need to determine if customer data is present before any external notice. Can secops pull a small sample for PII scan?
secops: pulling 100 object samples, running quick regex scan for emails, api_keys, and account ids. Early results: 3 files contain dev customer emails and 1 file contains an access token-looking string (masked). Treat as potential exposure.
legal-sam: Acknowledge. Please preserve chain-of-custody. We will advise on notification thresholds. Don't send external notices yet.
ada: immediate mitigations done: keys rotated, forwarder stopped, IPs blocked, quarantine snapshot completed. Commands run logged in incident doc. Next: restrict forwarder to VPC endpoint only + enforce KMS-only writes.
raj: secret rotation complete. New credentials pushed to Secrets Manager env `staging/forwarder`. Old creds disabled and scheduled for deletion. Planning a constrained restart behind VPC endpoint in 30m after config change.
cust-success-lee: Noted. I'll prep a customer template in case legal okays outreach. Need list of affected customer IDs — secops, can you provide?
secops: will provide permuted list (no raw emails) in 10m.
ad a: handoff: I'll stay for the config restart; oncall shift change in 15m so handing bridge to tasha who will carry monitoring overnight. Please add any follow-ups in the incident doc.
tasha: I'm on for handoff. Monitoring alerts and quarantine checks are in place. If we confirm exfil of customer PII we'll escalate to legal & support for outreach.
oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Acknowledged. Handoff assigned to `tasha`. Incident severity remains P2. Next update due in 30m or on major change.
ada: quick note with a snippet we used to list suspicious objects: `aws s3api list-objects --bucket staging-debug-logs --prefix mirror/2026-03-17/ --query 'Contents[].{Key:Key,Size:Size}'`
secops: forensic timeline and sample hashes uploaded to SECT-172. If anyone needs raw artifacts contact secops for access.
legal-sam: we'll triage and draft notification options contingent on full scan. Thanks team.
